description: This file contains the LoanForeclosureValidator class which performs validation checks for loan foreclosure operations, such as ensuring interest recalculation is not enabled, the transaction date is not in the future, and the date is not before the last transaction date.

classes.name: LoanForeclosureValidator
classes.description: Validator class for ensuring that loan foreclosure operations meet necessary preconditions.

methods.name: validateForForeclosure
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the loan object and transaction date to enforce business rules before foreclosure.
